vo.en: Press your arms against a doorframe.

visual.description: A man points his index finger directly at the camera with an intense and focused expression.

vo.en: Find a doorway and jam the back of your hands against the frame as hard as you can.

visual.description: Close up of a man's tensed hands pressing outward against a wooden door frame.

vo.en: Keep pushing hard. Your brain is sending electrical signals to your muscles, but your arms are frozen.

visual.description: Abstract digital animation showing glowing neural pathways and fast-moving electrical light pulses.

vo.en: Wait, this gets weirder. Keep the pressure for ten more seconds until your shoulders start to vibrate.

visual.description: Extreme close up of male shoulder muscle twitching under heavy physical strain.

vo.en: Now, step away into the open and let your arms hang. Watch as they float up like magic.

visual.description: A man stands in a hallway and his arms rise upward involuntarily to his sides.

vo.en: That is the Kohnstamm reflex. Subscribe for the next brain test, comment It worked, which is exactly why

visual.description: A close up of a hand clicking a red subscribe button on a smartphone screen.
